change_log.change: Added UK non-domestic ETL shower flow, pressure-independence and spray-coverage criteria as source-classified programme evidence.
Added current UK ETL electric-shower 4.5 / 9 / 10.6 L/min pathways conditional on power modulation, wastewater heat recovery and user-behaviour features.
Added 2025 DWHR fouling/system efficiency and October 2026 whole-system heat-pump/DWHR coupling evidence.
Corrected SANS Table 3 likely-maximum and design-pressure semantics using footnotes (a)/(b); added current EN 18021:2025 and UWL 2023 separate-inlet pressure criteria.
Added UWL 2023 boost-function definition and clause 12.1 test criteria; linked method-specific Rust validation.

Added ISO 20887:2020 and EN 45554:2020 as context-only standards references for design for disassembly and repairability-method concepts; direct fixture applicability and numeric thresholds remain unclaimed.
Added EN 18021:2025 separate shower-outlet and shower-system boost-function clauses, preserving the controlled-text limitation and preventing tap-specific thresholds from being transferred.
